# Shoaib Khan

> Shoaib Khan (Mohammed Shoaib Choudry, @beingashoaib) is a content creator, director, writer, video editor and entrepreneur from Hyderabad, India, and the CEO & Co-Founder of Hyderabad Hustlers, a podcast platform built to tell raw, authentic stories of entrepreneurs.

This is the official portfolio of Shoaib Khan: https://beingashoaib.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://beingashoaib.com/): introduction, experience, contact and FAQ
- [My Journey](https://beingashoaib.com/journey): his story and a year-by-year timeline from 2017 to today, with impact stats and collaborations

## About

- Has spent the last decade experimenting with storytelling in every form - from viral YouTube videos and short films to stand-up comedy and startup-focused podcasts.
- Started his journey in 2017 with one thought: "If The Baigan Vines can do such things in Hyderabad content creation, why not me?" He began creating sketches and short films that quickly went viral.
- 2018: directed his first Telugu short film.
- 2020: produced his most cinematic video yet.
- 2021–2022: dedicated time towards E-Sports.
- 2023: joined Edventure Park (India's 1st/largest student-focused startup incubator) and BioReform (content and media creator), was a panelist for the EdTalk topic "Influencer Influenza", and performed stand-up comedy.
- December 2023: started Hyderabad Hustlers (HH). It grew into a movement: direct incubation at EdVenture Park, 50+ entrepreneur stories, a 1M+ audience, brand collaborations, and a partnership with August Fest.
- 2024: joined Terminate Hunger.
- Mission: to inspire the youth of Hyderabad to build something of their own and follow their passions fearlessly.

## Experience

- Hyderabad Hustlers: CEO & Co-Founder
- Terminate Hunger: Terminator
- EdVenture Park: Campus Lead, Founders' Friday Lead, Founders' Fest Lead
- BioReform: Former Content & Media Creator

## Impact

- 50+ videos created
- 1M+ audience reached
- 15+ brands collaborated, including Edventure Park, BioReform, TEDx MJCET, Startup Hyderabad, Terminate Hunger and The August Fest
